_mica_template_note: HUMAN-FILL GUIDE. NOT schema-valid. Remove all _comment_* and _mica_* keys before validation. See mica-v0.1.8-minimal-instance.json for a valid example.
_comment_project: Project identity block. All six subfields are required.

project._comment_name: Short machine-safe slug. No spaces. Used in archive_id, file naming.
project.name: __REQUIRED: e.g. 'my-service'__
project._comment_version: Semver string matching pattern ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$. Must match your release.
project._comment_status: Free string. Typical values: active, stable, deprecated, experimental.
project._comment_purpose: One sentence: what does this project do?
project._comment_canonical_statement: Authoritative single sentence used as context anchor in AI sessions. Should name the project and its purpose unambiguously.
project.canonical_statement: __REQUIRED: e.g. 'My Service is an X that does Y for Z.'__

_comment_design_invariants: Array of structured invariant objects. v0.1.8+ only -- v0.1.7 used plain strings. Minimum 1 entry recommended. At least 1 critical severity DI is strongly advised.

design_invariants._comment_id: Sequential pattern DI-NNN. Must be unique within this archive.
design_invariants._comment_label: Short kebab-case name. Used in track_map references and inline invariants table.
design_invariants.label: __REQUIRED: e.g. 'no-external-deps'__
design_invariants._comment_statement: Complete binding rule text. Unambiguous. Written as a constraint, not a goal.
design_invariants._comment_severity: Enum: critical | high | medium | low. critical = session-blocking drift if violated.
design_invariants.severity: __REQUIRED: one of critical | high | medium | low__
design_invariants._comment_track: OPTIONAL. Track ID this DI applies to. If absent, applies to all tracks. Must match a key in track_map if track_map is present.

design_invariants.label: __REQUIRED__
design_invariants.severity: __REQUIRED: one of critical | high | medium | low__

_comment_provenance_registry: Array of file/URL records. minItems: 1. Must include every canonical file the AI session needs to verify (README, MICA JSON, key source files).

provenance_registry._comment_uri: Relative path from project root (e.g. 'README.md') or absolute URL.
provenance_registry._comment_sha256: SHA256 hex of the file at time of registration. 64 hex chars. Run: sha256sum README.md
provenance_registry._comment_kind: Enum: file | url | memory_export | artifact_ref | session_note
provenance_registry.kind: __REQUIRED: one of file | url | memory_export | artifact_ref | session_note__
provenance_registry._comment_created_at: ISO8601 datetime when this record was registered.
provenance_registry._comment_trust_class: Enum: canonical | distilled | raw | symbolic. Use canonical for source files and README.
provenance_registry.trust_class: __REQUIRED: one of canonical | distilled | raw | symbolic__
provenance_registry._comment_note: OPTIONAL. Free text description of this file's role.

_comment_invocation_protocol: Declares how this archive reaches an AI session. primary_pattern and loading_order are required.

invocation_protocol._comment_primary_pattern: Enum: readme_protocol | global_skill | workspace_directive | explicit. readme_protocol is recommended default -- embeds [AI Session Protocol] section in README.
invocation_protocol.primary_pattern: __REQUIRED: one of readme_protocol | global_skill | workspace_directive | explicit__
invocation_protocol._comment_loading_order: Ordered list of MICA JSON file paths to load. Most specific last. E.g. ['memory/project.mica.json'].
loading_order: __REQUIRED: list your MICA files in load order__
invocation_protocol._comment_readme_section_heading: OPTIONAL. Default: '## [AI Session Protocol]'. The README heading the AI scans to find session instructions.
invocation_protocol._comment_skill_name: OPTIONAL. Required only when primary_pattern is global_skill. The Agent Skills name.
invocation_protocol._comment_fallback_patterns: OPTIONAL. Ordered fallback list if primary_pattern fails. Same enum values.
invocation_protocol.fallback_patterns: __OPTIONAL: array of pattern strings or omit__
invocation_protocol._comment_self_test_runtime: OPTIONAL. Enum: readme_protocol_ai_session | python_validator | ci_pipeline | hybrid | none. Identifies which system runs self_test_policy checks. Use readme_protocol_ai_session for pure AI-session projects -- file_exists checks become read attempts, inline_invariants_match becomes README scan.
invocation_protocol.self_test_runtime: __OPTIONAL: one of readme_protocol_ai_session | python_validator | ci_pipeline | hybrid | none__

_comment_session_report_format: Defines what the AI prints at session start. All three fields required.

session_report_format._comment_trigger: Enum: session_start | on_first_tool_use | on_code_change. session_start is the recommended default.
session_report_format._comment_required_fields: List of named fields the AI must include in its opening report. Typical: ['gate', 'active_invariants', 'track', 'test_counts'].
required_fields: __REQUIRED: at least one field name, e.g. 'gate'__
session_report_format._comment_gate_block_on: Array of conditions that block the AI from proceeding. E.g. ['stage_gate_final==BLOCK'] means if the project gate is BLOCK, AI must not proceed. Empty array [] means no blocking.
session_report_format._comment_format_template: OPTIONAL. Template string with {placeholder} tokens. E.g. '[SESSION READY]\nGate: {gate}\nInvariants: {active_invariants}'

_comment_drift_response_policy: Defines AI behavior when provenance hashes don't match.

drift_response_policy._comment_on_hash_mismatch: Enum: warn_continue | warn_block | silent. warn_continue: notify and proceed. warn_block: notify and halt until acknowledged. silent: ignore (not recommended).
drift_response_policy._comment_on_file_missing: Enum: warn_continue | warn_block | silent. warn_block is recommended -- a missing registered file is a strong drift signal.
drift_response_policy._comment_reminder_after_change: true: AI reminds user to update provenance_registry SHA256 after modifying a registered file.
drift_response_policy._comment_inline_sync_required: OPTIONAL. true: README inline invariants table must match design_invariants on each update.

_comment_self_test_policy: Runnable checks that validate the archive against real-world project state. Distinct from self_consistency_policy (internal consistency).

self_test_policy._comment_enabled: Must be true. Const-enforced by schema.
self_test_policy._comment_run_on: Array of triggers. Enum values: session_start | pre_handoff | pre_commit | on_demand.
self_test_policy._comment_on_failure: Enum: warn_continue | block_session | require_acknowledgment. Policy-level default; individual checks can override with on_fail.

checks._comment_id: Unique check ID. Recommended pattern: ST-NNN.
checks._comment_description: Human-readable description of what this check validates.
checks._comment_check_type: Enum: provenance_sha256_format | provenance_file_exists | required_field_present | design_invariant_severity_valid | session_report_renderable | track_map_files_registered | invocation_pattern_present | inline_invariants_match | custom
checks.check_type: __REQUIRED: one of the check_type enum values__
checks._comment_expression: OPTIONAL. Machine-evaluable predicate using MICA expression micro-language (Section 10 of USAGE doc). Path references: $.field[*].subfield. Functions: exists(), all(), any(), match(), len(), contains(), file_exists(). Operators: and, or, not, ==, !=, >=, <=. If absent, check is human-only.
checks._comment_severity: Enum: warning | error | critical. Affects reporting level.

checks.description: All registered files exist at their stated URIs
All critical DIs appear in README [AI Session Protocol] inline invariants table
checks._comment_expression_note: inline_invariants_match checks require AI session scan -- expression field is optional here. AI verifies README manually.

_comment_track_map: OPTIONAL. Only add if project has 2+ logical file groups AND at least one DI applies to a subset. If absent, all DIs apply uniformly to all files.

track_map._comment_authority_note: designInvariantEntry.track is AUTHORITATIVE. trackEntry.invariants is DERIVED. Always update DI .track field first, then recompute invariants list here. Never edit invariants directly.

A.label: __REQUIRED: e.g. 'Core Logic'__
A._comment_description: OPTIONAL. Longer description of what belongs in this track.
A._comment_files: List of relative file paths belonging to this track. minItems: 1.
A._comment_invariants: DERIVED. List DI-IDs whose designInvariantEntry.track == 'A'. Compute from DI entries, do not edit directly.

_comment_scope: File inclusion/exclusion globs for the collector pipeline.

scope._comment_include: Array of glob patterns or paths to include. E.g. ['src/', 'README.md'].
scope._comment_exclude: Array of glob patterns to exclude. E.g. ['__pycache__/', '*.pyc', '.env'].

_comment_source_kinds: Object mapping kind names to sourceKind definitions. Add one entry per logical source category. Keys are arbitrary strings used in mapping_rules.

__YOUR_KIND_NAME__._comment_description: What type of files does this kind cover?
__YOUR_KIND_NAME__.default_tier: __REQUIRED: one of session | memory | artifact_ref | working__
__YOUR_KIND_NAME__.trust_class: __REQUIRED: one of canonical | distilled | raw | symbolic__

_comment_canonical_models: Shape descriptors for the six canonical data models. Copy from mica-v0.1.8-minimal-instance.json and add/remove optional fields as needed.

canonical_models._comment_copy_note: Copy the canonical_models block from mica-v0.1.8-minimal-instance.json. These are spec-level shape descriptors, not runtime validators.

_comment_invoke_role_semantics: Defines scoring bonuses for invoke_role values. Copy from minimal-instance.json. Change score_bonus values if you want different weighting.
_comment_invoke_role_semantics_change: Key decision: anchor score_bonus. Higher values pin anchor items more aggressively in scored context.
_comment_normalization_policy: Copy from minimal-instance.json. keep_category_order controls field ordering in canonical exports.
_comment_collector_pipeline: Copy from minimal-instance.json. steps string array is required. source_priority controls which trust class wins on conflict.
_comment_scoring_policy: Copy from mica-v0.1.8-minimal-instance.json and adjust weights. weights must sum to 1.0 (normalized_by_sum -- schema normalizes automatically, but keep them conceptually summing to 1.0 for clarity). Key decision fields:
_comment_scoring_weights: sim (semantic relevance), recency (time decay), invoke (role bonus), trust (trust_class value), continuity (prior session use). Increase sim for retrieval-heavy projects. Increase trust for governance-heavy projects.
_comment_scoring_gate_policy: min_similarity and min_trust are hard exclusion gates. Items below these thresholds are excluded regardless of other scores. anchor_trust_floor: anchors below this trust value are excluded too (prevents anchoring untrusted content).

scoring_policy._comment_see_minimal: Copy full block from mica-v0.1.8-minimal-instance.json. Change only weights and gate thresholds.
scoring_policy.one_shot_rule_text: If a context item is the sole relevant item for the current task, its score receives the invoke bonus from its invoke_role.

function.equation: score = sum_i(w_i * x_i), x_i in [0,1], weights normalized by sum, score clamped to [0,1]

scoring_policy._comment_weights_decision: Adjust these five values. Higher sim = more retrieval-focused. Higher trust = more governance-focused.

unknown_date_recency.rationale: Unknown date treated as medium recency

continuity.description: Session continuity -- items used in prior turns score higher

scoring_policy._comment_gate_decision: min_similarity=0.10 excludes totally irrelevant items. min_trust=0.25 excludes symbolic-class items. Tighten for stricter filtering.

_comment_dedup_policy: Copy from minimal-instance.json. semantic_cross_tier.enabled=false is safe default -- semantic dedup requires embedding infrastructure.
_comment_budget_policy: Key decision: max_tokens. Set to your model's usable context window minus prompt overhead. anchor_cap limits how many tokens anchored items can consume.

budget_policy._comment_max_tokens_decision: Typical values: 4000 (small context), 8000 (medium), 16000 (large). Leave room for system prompt and user message.
budget_policy._comment_anchor_cap_decision: Max tokens reserved for anchor items. If anchors exceed this, phase_5 emergency truncation triggers.

phase_1.description: Evict working-tier items below score threshold

phase_5.description: Emergency: truncate anchor items -- mark as degraded

_comment_mapping_rules: Array of rules mapping source_kinds to context_item properties. One rule per source kind is typical.

mapping_rules._comment_source: Must match a key in source_kinds.
mapping_rules._comment_match: Glob or OR-joined pattern. E.g. '*.py OR *.ts'.

to_context_item._comment_tier: Enum: session | memory | artifact_ref. Use memory for source code, artifact_ref for docs.
to_context_item._comment_invoke_role: OPTIONAL. Enum: none | hint | bridge | anchor.
to_context_item.invoke_role: __OPTIONAL: one of none | hint | bridge | anchor__
to_context_item.trust_class: __REQUIRED: one of canonical | distilled | raw | symbolic__
to_context_item._comment_labels: OPTIONAL. Array of tag strings for filtering.

_comment_handoff_policy: Copy from minimal-instance.json. Key decision: allowed_targets and deny_patterns for your security posture.
_comment_handoff_key_decisions: allowed_targets: which systems can receive compiled context. deny_patterns: file globs that are NEVER handed off (credentials, keys). redact: field names stripped from context items.
_comment_artifact_handle_policy: Copy from minimal-instance.json. signed_handles and expiry_required are const: true -- cannot be changed. Key decision: default_ttl_seconds.

artifact_handle_policy._comment_ttl_decision: How long (seconds) artifact handles remain valid. 3600 = 1 hour. Reduce for high-security contexts.

_comment_error_policy: Copy from minimal-instance.json. Key decision: target_policy_violation action -- this governs security boundary violations.
_comment_ledger_policy: Copy from minimal-instance.json. content_digest_only and hash_chain are const: true. Key decision: payload_fields -- what session metadata is hashed into the ledger.

ledger_policy._comment_payload_fields_decision: Fields included in each ledger entry hash. Minimum: session_id, timestamp_utc, context_hash. Add item_count and budget_used for richer audit trail.

_comment_cache_policy: Copy from minimal-instance.json. Cache is advisory. fail_safe=recompile_on_cache_miss means a miss is never an error.

cache_policy.note: Cache is advisory only. A cache miss is not an error.

_comment_schema_migration: Copy from minimal-instance.json. Key decision: compatibility_rules text -- document your project's semver semantics.

compatibility_rules._comment_patch_decision: What changes are allowed in a patch? Default: additive-only field additions.
compatibility_rules.patch: additive-only field additions, no removal, no semantic change
compatibility_rules._comment_minor_decision: What changes are allowed in a minor? Default: new optional fields, deprecations.
compatibility_rules.minor: new optional fields, deprecations, non-breaking semantic clarifications
compatibility_rules._comment_major_decision: What changes require a major version? Default: field removal, breaking changes.
compatibility_rules.major: breaking field changes, removal, scoring model changes

migration_strategy: validate existing archive against new schema

_comment_observability: Copy from minimal-instance.json. Key decision: slo_hints values -- set thresholds that match your project's performance expectations. p95 must be <= p99. degraded_rate_warn must be < degraded_rate_critical.

slo_hints._comment_compile_ms: p95 must be <= p99. Start with 200/500 and tune based on observed compile times.
slo_hints._comment_failure_rates: degraded_rate_warn must be < degraded_rate_critical. 0.05/0.15 are reasonable defaults.

_comment_acceptance_criteria: Array of strings. What must be true for this archive to be considered valid and operational?
acceptance_criteria: __REQUIRED: e.g. 'All required fields present and schema-valid'__
_comment_non_goals: Array of strings. What does this archive explicitly NOT do? Prevents scope creep.
_comment_artifact_manifest: Records all canonical output files. generated_at_utc, root, and at least one entry are required.

artifact_manifest._comment_root: Root path for relative entry paths. '.' means project root.

entries._comment_role: Semantic role of this file. E.g. 'primary_protocol', 'mica_archive', 'source_module'.
entries._comment_sha256: SHA256 of file at time of manifest generation.
entries._comment_required: true if this file must exist for the project to be operational.
entries._comment_produced_by_stage: Which stage produced this file. E.g. 'S1' for initial setup.

_comment_deviation_log: Array of change records. Can be empty []. Add entries when design_invariants are intentionally violated or when the archive deviates from expected state.
_comment_prompt_safety_profile: Defines content safety constraints for AI sessions.

prompt_safety_profile._comment_profile_name: Enum: universal_operational_archive | site_maintenance | governance_methodology | research_laboratory. Use universal_operational_archive for most projects.
prompt_safety_profile.profile_name: __REQUIRED: one of the profile_name enum values__
prompt_safety_profile._comment_allowed_scope: Array of scope strings. What topics/domains is AI allowed to assist with?
prompt_safety_profile._comment_blocked_claim_types: Array. What claim types must AI refuse to generate? E.g. 'efficacy_claims' for medical projects.
prompt_safety_profile._comment_enforcement_mode: Enum: hard_block | warn_and_redact. hard_block refuses outright. warn_and_redact strips and flags.
prompt_safety_profile._comment_redact_patterns: Array of strings/phrases to strip from AI output. E.g. ['clinical trial', 'FDA'] for regulated projects.

_comment_semantic_validation_policy: Cross-field validation rules that JSON Schema cannot enforce. Copy SV-001 and SV-002 from minimal-instance.json (they validate SLO ordering). Add project-specific rules as SV-003+.

semantic_validation_policy.json_schema_limits_note: Cross-field ordering constraints (p95 <= p99, degraded_rate_warn < degraded_rate_critical) cannot be enforced by JSON Schema alone.

rules._comment_expression: Use MICA expression micro-language. See Section 10 of USAGE doc.
rules.expression: __OPTIONAL: your cross-field rule or remove this entry__

_comment_self_consistency_policy: Internal document consistency checks. mode and behavior_on_failure are const -- cannot be changed. Key decision: doc_sanity_checks expressions.

self_consistency_policy._comment_algorithm: Hash algorithm for consistency checks. Do not change.
self_consistency_policy._comment_version_source: Enum: artifact_filename | external_release_registry | explicit_archive_header. Use explicit_archive_header for MICA archives (version declared in mica_schema_version field).
self_consistency_policy._comment_required_equalities: Array of equality assertions. At least one required. Standard: mica_schema_version must match $id.
required_equalities: mica_schema_version must match schema $id version component
self_consistency_policy._comment_doc_sanity_checks: Project-specific sanity checks. At least one required. SC-001 and SC-002 from minimal-instance.json are good defaults.

_comment_operation_meta: Operational metadata. archive_id must match pattern MICA-[A-Za-z0-9\-]+.

operation_meta._comment_baseline_ref: Version or date snapshot this archive was baselined against. E.g. 'v1.0.0-2026-01-01'.
operation_meta._comment_objective: What is this archive trying to achieve? One sentence.
operation_meta._comment_operating_mode: Enum: observe | maintain | govern | evolve. observe = read-only. maintain = routine upkeep. govern = strict drift enforcement. evolve = active architecture change.
operation_meta.operating_mode: __REQUIRED: one of observe | maintain | govern | evolve__
operation_meta._comment_current_state: Enum: active | stable | transitional | degraded | archived.
operation_meta.current_state: __REQUIRED: one of active | stable | transitional | degraded | archived__
operation_meta._comment_update_count: Integer. Increment each time this archive is substantively updated.

domain_status._comment_domain_status: Per-domain health. Each is one of: pending | active | stable | blocked | deprecated.
domain_status.identity: __REQUIRED: one of pending | active | stable | blocked | deprecated__
domain_status.content: __REQUIRED: one of pending | active | stable | blocked | deprecated__
domain_status.operations: __REQUIRED: one of pending | active | stable | blocked | deprecated__
domain_status.growth: __REQUIRED: one of pending | active | stable | blocked | deprecated__

operation_meta._comment_invocation_notes: OPTIONAL. Human note about how this archive is invoked in AI sessions. Useful for onboarding.
operation_meta.invocation_notes: __OPTIONAL: e.g. 'Primary invocation via README [AI Session Protocol].'__
